introHtml: Pizza cutters that survive the dishwasher mean less hassle for your team after the office party or promotional event. Stainless steel blades and heat-resistant handles ensure these custom pizza cutters come out clean and rust-free cycle after cycle. For marketing directors stocking breakrooms or HR managers planning employee appreciation gifts, the dishwasher-safe feature adds real convenience. Decorate with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a crisp, lasting mark that won't fade in the wash.
